name: ping-identity-pingone
description: Agent plugin for PingOne. App-integration guidance for connecting web, mobile, and backend applications to a PingOne environment (SDK wiring, OIDC/PKCE, CORS, Worker applications), DaVinci flow design guidance for building flows (registration, login, MFA, step-up, passkeys), and MCP-backed troubleshooting for live DaVinci flow executions.
